notizie.titolo: Norwegian DPA fines Xandr EUR 8 600 000 for unlawful processing of personal data
notizie.descrizione: Background information Date of final decision: 2 October 2026 National case Controller: Xandr Inc. Legal References: Article 6 (Lawfulness of processing), Article 9 (Processing of special categories of personal data) Decision: Administrative fine Key words: Fines, Basic principles, Marketing, Online platforms Summary of the Decision Origin of the case The case started in 2020 when the Norwegian Consumer Council lodged a complaint against the advertising technology company Xandr (at the time AppNexus, now a part of Microsoft) with the Norwegian DPA (Data Protection Authority). The case concerns real-time bidding in Grindr, a location-based dating app aimed at gay, bi, trans and queer people.

notizie.titolo: EDPB publishes statement on the data protection challenges of smart glasses
notizie.descrizione: Brussels, 13 October – During its latest plenary, the EDPB has adopted statement 1/2026 on smart glasses and published the report “The connected gaze. Video recording, surveillance and administering evidence in the age of smart glasses” *, developed in the context of the Support Pool of Expert (SPE) programme **.
